ko.title: 와르르 무너진 성
ko.body: 강아지 두두가 뛰어가다 친구 다람쥐의 모래성을 발로 차 버렸어요. 정성껏 쌓은 성이 와르르 무너졌지요.

en.title: The Castle Came Tumbling Down
en.body: Dudu the puppy was running and kicked over his friend Squirrel's sandcastle. The carefully built castle came tumbling down.

ko.title: 속상한 다람쥐
ko.body: 다람쥐는 무너진 성을 보며 눈물을 글썽였어요. 아침 내내 만든 소중한 성이었으니까요.

en.title: A Sad Squirrel
en.body: Squirrel looked at the ruined castle with tears welling up. He had spent the whole morning making it.

ko.title: 모른 척
ko.body: 두두는 괜히 부끄러워 모른 척 고개를 돌렸어요. "그냥 모래성인데, 뭐"라고 중얼거렸지요.

en.title: Pretending Not to Notice
en.body: Feeling embarrassed, Dudu turned away and pretended not to notice. “It's just a sandcastle, anyway,” he mumbled.
en.line: But one corner of his heart kept stinging.

ko.title: 혼자 떠난 친구
ko.body: 다람쥐는 시무룩하게 자리를 떠났어요. 두두는 친구의 뒷모습을 바라보며 마음이 무거워졌지요.

en.title: A Friend Walks Away
en.body: Squirrel walked off all by himself, feeling glum. Dudu watched his friend's back and felt heavy inside.

ko.title: 엄마의 물음
ko.body: 엄마 강아지가 두두의 마음을 가만히 물었어요. 미안한 마음이 들면 그 마음을 전하면 된다고 했지요.

en.title: Mama's Question
en.body: Mama Dog gently asked Dudu how he was feeling. If you feel sorry, she said, you can share that feeling.
en.line: “What should I do when I'm sorry?”

ko.title: 친구를 찾아서
ko.body: 두두는 용기를 내어 다람쥐를 찾아갔어요. 가슴이 콩콩 뛰었지만 꼭 사과하고 싶었답니다.

en.title: Looking for His Friend
en.body: Dudu gathered his courage and went to find Squirrel. His heart was pounding, but he really wanted to apologize.
en.line: “Squirrel, can we talk for a minute?”

ko.title: 진심을 담아
ko.body: 두두는 다람쥐의 눈을 보며 또박또박 말했어요. 모래성을 망가뜨려서 정말 미안하다고요.

en.title: From the Heart
en.body: Dudu looked Squirrel in the eyes and spoke clearly. He said he was truly sorry for breaking the castle.
en.line: “I'm sorry I knocked down your castle.”

ko.title: 풀린 마음
ko.body: 진심 어린 사과에 다람쥐의 마음이 스르르 풀렸어요. 다람쥐는 고개를 끄덕이며 괜찮다고 했지요.

en.title: A Heart at Ease
en.body: At the heartfelt apology, Squirrel's feelings gently softened. He nodded and said it was okay.
en.line: “Thank you for being honest with me.”

ko.title: 같이 다시 쌓기
ko.body: 두두는 다람쥐와 함께 더 멋진 모래성을 쌓았어요. 둘이 만드니 성은 더 크고 튼튼해졌답니다.

en.title: Building Again Together
en.body: Dudu and Squirrel built an even grander castle together. With the two of them, it grew bigger and stronger.
en.line: “It's even cooler now that we made it together!”

ko.title: 미안해의 힘
ko.body: 두두는 진심으로 미안하다고 말하면 다시 친해질 수 있다는 걸 알았어요. 작은 사과가 큰 마음을 이어 주었지요.

en.title: The Power of Sorry
en.body: Dudu learned that a heartfelt sorry can bring friends back together. One small apology mended a big friendship.
en.line: “'Sorry'—just one word, and it's like magic!”
